scientific_integrity: Analytic all-radius proof; independent exact finite checker corroborates but is not substituted for an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to the rigid 21-neighbor tiling; no graph-isoperimetric minimizing claim. Geometric rigidity imported from published preprint, original 1975 construction not fully inspected, priority is provisional and independent audit not performed.
title: Exact graph balls and contact-edge boundaries in the 21-neighbor convex tiling
